list: The official 55 trophies, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum unlocks automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned — follow the 7-stage roadmap in order and it pops last.
steps: Earn every other trophy in this guide, stage by stage.
Finish the story first, then strands, collectibles and grind trophies.
Check the roadmap view: when all seven stages read 100%, the platinum unlocks.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission Gone Fishing — it is the first story mission, so this pops early in Chapter 1.
steps: Play through the opening of the game until the mission Gone Fishing starts.
Follow the on-screen objectives to the end of the mission.
The trophy unlocks when the mission completes; if you replay the chapter, it still counts.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Play through every Chapter 1 story mission to the end of the chapter; no side content is required for this one.
steps: Work through the Chapter 1 mission list in order.
Complete each story mission as it appears on the map.
The trophy pops when the final Chapter 1 mission ends and Chapter 2 begins.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every Chapter 2 story mission; grab the Chapter 2 missable trophies on your way through, before the chapter closes.
steps: Play the Chapter 2 missions in order.
Before the last Chapter 2 mission, finish any Chapter 2 missables still open.
The trophy pops when Chapter 2 ends.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Play through all Chapter 3 story missions to the end of the chapter; character-strand missions in this stretch count toward their own trophies.
steps: Follow the Chapter 3 mission list in order.
Clear the character missions that open during the chapter.
The trophy pops when Chapter 3 ends and Chapter 4 begins.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish the Chapter 4 story missions; this is the last chapter before the finale, so clear remaining missables first.
steps: Play the Chapter 4 missions in order.
Before the final mission, check the Missables view for anything still open.
The trophy pops when Chapter 4 ends.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the game's final mission — the story's last beat, worth gold, and the gateway to free-roam cleanup.
steps: Finish Chapter 4 and start the final mission when it appears.
Complete the final mission's objectives.
The gold trophy pops at the mission's end; free roam then opens for cleanup.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run when it appears; do it on your first pass through the chapter so it cannot slip by.
steps: Play the story until the Breakfast Run mission marker appears.
Start the mission and follow its objectives to the end.
The trophy pops on mission completion.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist — a big set-piece heist mission in the middle chapters.
steps: Play the story until The Cartel Heist mission unlocks.
Complete the heist's setup and execution objectives.
The trophy pops when the heist mission ends.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play when it appears in the mission list.
steps: Play the story until the Child's Play mission marker appears.
Finish the mission's objectives.
The trophy pops on completion.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners in the later chapters.
steps: Play the story until the Headliners mission unlocks.
Complete its objectives to the end.
The trophy pops on mission completion.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown — the airport takedown mission, tied to the Catch Me If You Can feat.
steps: Play the story until the VCIA Takedown mission appears.
Complete the takedown objectives at the airport.
The trophy pops on mission completion.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory in the late chapters.
steps: Play the story until Operation Savage Glory unlocks.
Complete its objectives to the end.
The trophy pops on mission completion.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion on the in-game checklist — story, strands, collectibles and activities all count, so this is the last gold before the platinum.
steps: Finish the story and all character and stranger strands.
Clear every collectible set and activity trophy in this guide.
Open the in-game 100% checklist to find the last items, then finish them for the gold.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts — jumps, near-misses, drifts and airtime all feed the counter; grind it in free roam after the story.
steps: Drive fast and take jumps, ramps and near-misses in free roam.
Each stunt adds to the counter shown in this guide's stepper.
Keep going until the counter reads 250/250.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types once — shooting range, drone race, racing, fishing, arcade, bowling, stunts, challenges and partner activities each count once.
steps: Open the activities list and note the 9 types.
Try each type once — a single attempt counts, no win needed.
The trophy pops after the ninth different type.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges — learn each range's target pattern, then chase gold one challenge at a time.
steps: Visit a shooting range and open its challenge list (42 challenges).
Play each challenge and beat its gold-medal score.
Repeat until all 42 show gold; the silver trophy pops with the last one.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations — each location is a separate race, so you must win at every one.
steps: Find the Top Fun drone race markers across Leonida (14 locations).
Win the race at each location.
The trophy pops after the 14th location's win.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each race counts once, so vary the events instead of repeating one favourite.
steps: Open the race list and pick races you have not won yet.
Win each race; a repeat win of the same race does not add to the count.
The trophy pops at 20 different race wins.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge — challenge him when the fishing activity opens and out-fish his catch.
steps: Unlock fishing and find Cal's fishing challenge.
Accept the challenge and fish against him.
Beat his catch to take the trophy; do it when the challenge first appears, before moving on.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game — walk into any arcade, pick a cabinet and play it through to the end.
steps: Find an arcade in Vice City or elsewhere in Leonida.
Start any arcade game.
Finish the game to completion for the trophy.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand to its final mission — take every Andy mission as it appears until his story closes.
steps: Meet Andy and take his first mission.
Keep accepting Andy's missions as they unlock.
Complete his final mission for the trophy.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand to its final mission — work through his missions in order until his story ends.
steps: Meet Kenton and take his first mission.
Complete each Kenton mission as it unlocks.
Finish his final mission for the trophy.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand to its final mission — take his missions as they appear until his story closes.
steps: Meet Billy and take his first mission.
Complete each Billy mission as it unlocks.
Finish his final mission for the trophy.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida — each stranger's full strand counts once, so finish eight of them.
steps: Look for stranger markers (question marks) across the map.
Play a stranger's strand through to its end.
Repeat until 8 strands are complete for the silver.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand to its final mission — take his missions in order until his story closes.
steps: Meet Randy and take his first mission.
Complete each Randy mission as it unlocks.
Finish his final mission for the trophy.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand to its final mission — take his missions in order until his story closes.
steps: Meet Tyrone and take his first mission.
Complete each Tyrone mission as it unlocks.
Finish his final mission for the trophy.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida — visit each spot and complete the meditation there.
steps: Find the meditation spots scattered across Leonida (18 in total).
Stand at a spot and start the meditation.
Repeat at every spot; the trophy pops at the 18th.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal for Bret — take the hunt when Bret offers it and track the animal to its location.
steps: Meet Bret and accept the hunting job.
Track the unique animal to where it roams.
Take it down cleanly for the trophy.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets — find the cards hidden around Leonida and finish three full sets.
steps: Collect cards found around Leonida — shops, interiors and hidden spots.
Open the collection screen to see which sets are close to complete.
Finish 3 full sets for the silver.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations — use the WAiNK app at photo spots across Leonida until the counter hits 100.
steps: Open the WAiNK app at scenic and landmark spots.
WAiNK It at each new location.
Keep going until the counter reads 100/100.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges — the in-game challenge list spans driving, combat and exploration, so chip away at it in free roam.
steps: Open the challenges list in the pause menu.
Complete challenges across the different categories.
The trophy pops at 50 completed challenges.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you — build the heat together, then break line of sight and escape.
steps: Bring your partner along and raise your wanted level to 4 stars.
Break away from the police and stay out of their search cones.
When the wanted level clears with your partner beside you, the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level — keep the heat on through all three robberies.
steps: Bring your partner and rob a first shop to gain a wanted level.
Move straight to a second shop and rob it, then a third, without clearing the wanted level.
The trophy pops after the third consecutive robbery.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — drive or ride any new vehicle and it counts; variety across Leonida fills the list fastest.
steps: Drive any vehicle you have not driven before — each new one counts.
Check the vehicle list to see what is still undiscovered.
Keep trying new cars, bikes, boats and planes until 100.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in one use of Combat Focus — trigger it in a busy fight and chain five takedowns before it ends.
steps: Get into a fight with at least 5 enemies nearby.
Activate Combat Focus.
Down 5 enemies before Combat Focus runs out.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA airport — get a plane off the ground without a scheduled flight.
steps: Head to Vice City International Airport.
Get into a plane on the tarmac.
Take off without a scheduled departure to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Deal with the Rhinos — survive and fight back while military tanks are on you, then clear the heat.
steps: Raise your wanted level until Rhino tanks roll in.
Fight or evade the tanks and survive the encounter.
The trophy pops when the Rhino encounter is resolved.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected — plan a quiet entry, take the goods and leave before any alarm.
steps: Pick a jewelry store and scout its layout and guards.
Enter quietly and take the valuables without triggering detection.
Leave the store undetected for the trophy.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time — hit five vaults across Leonida and get clear after every one.
steps: Find a bank with a robbable vault.
Rob the vault and escape the police response.
Repeat at four more banks for the silver.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape — stop a truck on the road, crack it open and lose the heat.
steps: Find an armored truck driving its route.
Stop the truck and force it open.
Grab the cash and escape the wanted level.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida — drive through every named area until the map is fully revealed.
steps: Open the map and note which areas are still unvisited.
Drive through each of the 52 areas.
The trophy pops when the last area is explored.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs — one hit per gang, across their territories.
steps: Find an illegal operation run by one gang and rob it.
Move on to the next gang's operation.
Repeat until all 9 gangs have been hit.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach — find a beachfront bar, order a cocktail and take in the view.
steps: Go to Ocean Beach and find a bar with a view.
Order a cocktail there.
The trophy pops as you enjoy the drink with the view.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive a car straight through the showroom glass.
steps: Find a vehicle showroom and get a car inside or near its entrance.
Drive through the showroom front in classic smash-and-grab style.
The trophy pops as you break out.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — play a full game of bowling there.
steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Start a game of bowling.
Play it through to the end for the trophy.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Build a partnership moment with mass appeal — do a partner activity that draws a crowd and lands well.
steps: Do a partner activity with your companion.
Play to the crowd and finish it in style.
The trophy pops when the partnership moment lands.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make choices across the story — PlayStation tracks a count of 500 choices, so keep choosing at every story fork.
steps: Play the story and choose at every decision point offered.
Each choice adds to the tracked count toward 500.
The trophy pops when the count is reached.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try — fail an attempt at something, then nail it on the immediate retry.
steps: Attempt an activity or challenge and fail it once.
Retry it right away.
Succeed on the second attempt for the trophy.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange — find one of Leonida's odd encounters out in the world and let it play out.
steps: Explore the stranger corners of Leonida, especially at night.
Trigger an odd encounter when one appears.
The trophy pops when the strange event plays out.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl someone over with a melee drive-by — swing a melee weapon from a moving vehicle and knock a pedestrian down.
steps: Get a melee weapon and a vehicle.
Drive past a pedestrian and strike with the melee weapon from the moving car.
The trophy pops when the drive-by connects.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts — collect marked bills from robberies and launder them until the total hits $250,000.
steps: Collect Marked Bills from robberies and heists.
Launder them through your contacts.
Keep laundering until $250,000 has been earned.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — clothes, weapons, food and cars all count toward the total.
steps: Spend money at any shops across Leonida.
Track the running total in this guide's counter.
The trophy pops at $100,000 spent.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties — buy every garage on the property market to store your collection.
steps: Open the property listings and find the garages (8 in total).
Buy each garage as you can afford it.
The trophy pops when the eighth garage is purchased.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app — open the app, register a vehicle, and repeat with ten different ones.
steps: Open the Scooter Bros app on the in-game phone.
Register a vehicle to the app.
Repeat with 10 different vehicles for the trophy.
